per_candidate.id: s2:A Search for Rapid Mid-infrared Variability in Gamma-Ray-emitting Narrow-line Se, 2021-07-01

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the relationship between X-ray variability amplitude and X-ray photon indices in ULXs with lower luminosities or its implications for accretion processes in supermassive black holes compared to BHBs.
